name: Button
description: Triggers an action. Pill-shaped, monochrome primary with a subtle lift on hover.

classes.ayy-button: Root. Alone it is the primary button.
classes.ayy-button--secondary: Quiet filled button for secondary actions.
classes.ayy-button--outline: Bordered, transparent. Neutral alternative to secondary.
classes.ayy-button--ghost: No border or fill until hover. Toolbars, icon buttons.
classes.ayy-button--ring: Showcase call to action: quiet fill inside a gradient ring that spins on hover and focus. For marketing and portfolio pages; one per view.
classes.ayy-button--block: Fills its container's width: a card footer, a phone form, a dialog's only action.

default.looks: Primary: --ayy-color-primary fill, --ayy-color-primary-fg label, semibold. Secondary: wash fill and line border. Outline: transparent with a line-strong border. Ghost: transparent, no border. Destructive: 10% red tint, red label. Link: plain text. Ring: wash inside a gradient ring.

hover.looks: Lifts 2px. Primary adds the glow shadow at 90% opacity; secondary, outline, ghost and ring move to wash-hover, wash or highlight with a stronger border; destructive deepens to a 15% tint. Link underlines instead of lifting; ring's border spins.

pressed.looks: Drops back to its resting position while held; colours stay as on hover.

focus.looks: 2px --ayy-color-ring outline, 2px offset. Ring also spins its border.

disabled.looks: --ayy-opacity-disabled, ignores the pointer. Forced colours: GrayText border and label.

selected.none: Not a toggle. For on/off use a Chip button (aria-pressed), for one of a few a Segmented control, for a setting a Switch.

error.none: Errors belong to the form: a FieldError under the field, or an Alert for a failed action.

loading.when: aria-busy="true" with an aria-hidden .ayy-spinner as the first child (React: loading)
loading.looks: Spinner before the label; clicks and form submits are ignored; stays focusable. Keep the label (or "Saving…") so the width barely moves.

scale.sm: Control sm height (28px compact, 32 comfortable, 40 touch), sm padding and text.
scale.md: Control md height (32px compact, 40 comfortable, 44 touch).
scale.lg: Control lg height (40px compact, 48 comfortable, 52 touch), more padding, larger text.
scale.icon: Square at the md height, for one icon (needs aria-label).

sizes.density: Height, inline padding and label size follow data-density (the heights above).
sizes.width: Hugs its label. block (ayy-button--block) fills its container: a phone form, a card footer, a dialog's only action.

js: buttonClass({ variant?, size?, block?, className? }) → string. Loading in HTML: aria-busy="true" plus as the first child.

props.loading: boolean — a Spinner before the label and aria-busy="true"; clicks and form submits are ignored while it's set. Stays focusable.

a11y: Use disabled on <button>; on <a> use aria-disabled="true" (the class handles both).
Visible focus ring on :focus-visible is built in — never remove it.
While it works, set aria-busy="true" and put an aria-hidden .ayy-spinner first inside (React: loading). Don't disable it: focus would jump away.
do: Use a button for any action the user can take: submit, open, save, delete.
Apply buttonClass() to an <a> when a link should look like an action.
Keep one primary button per view or section; make everything else secondary, outline or ghost.
On a marketing or portfolio page, the one call to action can be ring instead of primary, with an outline button beside it.
Put the icon (<Icon> or an .ayy-icon <svg>) before the label; the button sizes it (1.25em).
dont: Don't use a button for navigation inside running text — use a plain link.
Don't use a button to toggle a setting on/off — use Switch.
Don't restyle colours per button — add a variant to the design system instead.
Don't use destructive for non-destructive emphasis.
